notes.title: Release 1.4
notes.content:
Tumbling has been added to the game.  When the player holds the down button and impacts the ground while moving forward, Eleanor will tumble instead of having landing lag.  Tumbling gives Eleanor boosted movement speed during the tumble and she can jump out of the tumble to preserve her speed as she leaps into the air.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136666/f9d289d55aaea1e14da42e2510bbf1c1fc3bdb4c.gif[/img]

Wings have been added to the game.  When Eleanor collects a purple orb, she'll have wings that can give her an upward boost.  Holding the jump button while Eleanor is falling activates the wings.  The faster Eleanor is falling, the greater the upwards boost she gets.  Wings are lost on death.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136666/4bd512d2c2ac6a57474e44d1b976642676bb5963.gif[/img]

[h1]Eleanor[/h1]
- The Moon Jump cheat that caused low gravity has been replaced with Vengeance.  Vengeance gives eleanor permanent Wings as it clashes a lot less than low gravity did with axe bounces.
- If Eleanor gets hit while having Bloodrush, blood loss will be prevented.  Bloodrush will still be lost.
- Eleanor's minimum jump time has been increased to 0.08 seconds from 0.03 under normal, water, climbing, wall hiking or jumping-off-an-abductee conditions; she'll at least clear 1 tile.  Smaller jumps may still be desirable when jumping from a wall or a platform.
- The player must hold jump for 15 frames before they will jump off an abductee up from 10.

[h1]Monsters[/h1]
- Succubus:  She'll come slightly closer to the player before retreating, making her slightly easier.  Changed her projectile to the fire element so it no longer causes knockback.

[h1]Bosses[/h1]
- Skeleton Army:  When the player dies and respawns, the skeletons now start spawning two waves back instead of having to start the waves over from the beginning each time.
- Vampire Hunters:  When the player dies and respawns, the vampire hunters will have only two more hunters than the player had vanquished on the previous round instead of having to start over with the full 12 hunters each time.
- Lich:  No longer starts off with his fireball hand glowing.

[h1]Levels[/h1]
- Cosmetic mushrooms have been added to a few levels.
- Candles have been added to various levels.  Most of them are cosmetic and they blow out if you touch them.
- Added multiple shadowy tiles to various levels to help breakup some monotonous geometry.
- Catacombs: Doors inside the Catacombs stage will now be closed if the player has collected all the coins from that room.
- Tower:  In the first room, the left side wall jumps have had the spikes replaced with soul stealing hooks.
- Docks:  Pushed back the first Henchman on the first boat so he's less likely to see the player if they immediately land in the water.
- Woods:  Made the tree trunk jump right after the first gargoyles much easier.
- Storm:  Doors in the storm stage will now be closed if the player has already lowered the water a level from that area.
- Ascent:  Adjusted the gargoyles on the right to make them easier.  Made some destructable blocks a bit more obvious.

notes.title: Release 1.3
notes.content:
*General*
- For the month of October, Jack O'Lanterns will appear in most levels that can be smashed for a trick or treat.
- Fixed (mostly) a pop in the ambient night audio track.
- In the control configuration menu, the key binding selection will no longer skip when navigating up or down from the Back button.

*Eleanor*
- Eleanor's movement will now decelerate at 6 instead of 8 when landing on the ground so that she slides further.

*Humans*
- Detection build up has been slowed down at long distance.
- Instant detection distance reduced to about 2.5 tiles from 3.5 tiles.
- Henchman: Bullet speed reduced to 9 from 10.
- Matron: Bullet speed reduced to 5 from 6.
- Sultress: Bullet speed reduced to 5 from 6, magazine size reduced to 5 from 6 and reload time increased to 1.25 from 0.65.
- Priest: Bullet speed reduced to 5 from 6.

*Monsters*
- Cold Touch:  Reduced their spawn box to 384 width 256 height from 448 width 320 height and now spawns moving away from the player so that they have more time to react.
- Iron Devil:  Fixed a bug where it's firebreath hitbox wouldn't switch directions.
- Vampire Hunters:  Reduced the number of vampire hunters to 12 from 14.
- Heart of Thorns:  Individual thorn hitboxes have been shrunk to 8x8 from 12x12.  Body damage hitboxes shrunk to 24x28 and 16x40 from 32x36 and 16x48 so that it's easier to attack without getting hit.
- Krampus:  Will now knock the player through himself while traveling fast or knock away when slow or stationary, resulting in fewer sudden deaths.  Krampus' horns are now visible while underground and takes an extra half second to submerge/emerge.
- Lich:  The fireball graphic is now pixel aligned in his hand (cosmetic change).

*Levels*
- 1-1: Added an extra bloodorb after the first victim and swapped positions with a soul so bloodrush can be maintained.  Extended a ledge before the crawl space before the axe so it's easier for some folks to jump into it.
- 2-1: Pushed the starting trees a bit closer so they're easier to zip line off of, pushed back a mudman and adjusted the last checkpoint.
- 3-3: Made the first secret door a little more obvious and sealed up the last two false doors.
- Castle:  Adjusted the checkpoint in the white room and adjusted a mini room so that a vambat is less likely to pass over the player while they are being shot at.

notes.title: Release 1.2
notes.content:
- All coins hidden behind objects in level 3-2 (catacombs) have been made visible so they can't be missed.
- Added a few souls in level 4-3 (mansion).
- Corrected a pixel art error on the Dragons.

notes.title: Release 1.1 (quick fix)
notes.content: - Fixed a glitch on the overworld map that would sometimes cause the player to get lodged inside walls.
